lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: Hardest part is deciding what to make. Everything else is fine.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Zepto mostly. Let's not sign in now, just go ahead.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Zepto is the main one. Sometimes blinkit if zepto doesn't have something.
Q: I have Amit (40), Snehal (38), Aditi (10) and Ishaan (6) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: No one else, just the four of us.
Q: Mangala cooks Mon-Fri: Breakfast and Lunch at 7am, Dinner at 6pm. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: Yes, that's right. Just those three meals on weekdays.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: No, she's fine on time. Makes full meals.
Q: On Saturday and Sunday, when the cook doesn't come, who cooks? Or is a meal eaten out?
A: I cook Saturday, Snehal does Sunday.
A: actually Mangala comes at 6:45 in the morning now
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Poha, upma, sheera, and thalipeeth on the weekend. Weekdays she makes whatever we have, usually those same things.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: School tiffin is sandwich, fruits, chivda, idli. Noodles sometimes on Friday for Ishaan.
A: They eat that at school.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: Same as ours: bhakri or poli with usal or pithla. Fish fry on Saturday dinner, chicken rassa on Sunday lunch.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Same as kids. Poha, upma, sheera, thalipeeth on weekends. Mangala makes it for all of us.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Lunch is poli, bhaji, varan bhaat, koshimbir. Sometimes amti instead of varan.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Same as I said for the kids. Bhakri or poli with usal or pithla.
A: Fish fry Saturday dinner, chicken rassa Sunday lunch.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: No diets, nothing special.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: Non-veg only on weekends, Saturday and Sunday. Ishaan is allergic to peanuts, so nothing with peanuts for him, not even groundnut oil. Eggs are fine.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Rarely. Only if we're super busy, maybe once in two weeks or so.
A: Weekend mostly if we do, but not fixed.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: Chitale milk every morning, that's a daily subscription.
Q: Do you cook everything without peanuts, or only Ishaan's food?
A: Everything at home is without peanuts, we don't even use groundnut oil.
